design_detail: Progressive tax on total wealth of private-law persons worth USD 1 million or more: 8 brackets from 0.5% (USD 1-5m) to 7% (over USD 1bn)
quote_original: تقدّم النائب تيمور جنبلاط في 14/4/2021 باقتراح قانون ينشئ ضريبة على الثروة.
quote_en: On 14 April 2021 MP Taymour Joumblatt submitted a bill proposal that creates a tax on wealth.
source_title: اقتراح إنشاء ضريبة على الثروة: ضريبة بحاجة لدراسة جدوى اقتصادي
grading_note: Formal act: the sponsor of the bill proposal, as reported by the Legal Agenda Parliamentary Observatory, which also prints the brackets; the Parliament page for the bill was not found.

quote_original: من باب العدالة الاجتماعية لا بد من فرض ضريبة على الثروة كما في فرنسا لحث الميسورين على المساهمة بدل التهرب والتكابر
quote_en: In the name of social justice a wealth tax must be imposed, as in France, to push the well-off to contribute instead of evading and being arrogant.
source_title: جنبلاط: لفرض ضريبة على الثروة كما في فرنسا
grading_note: His own tweet, quoted by Lebanon24, calling for a wealth tax by name without a rate; the French reference is to the wealth tax (ISF) then in force.

design_detail: 2% on the net wealth of individuals above USD 1 million
quote_original: وضع ضريبة 2% على الثروة الصافية للأفراد فوق المليون دولار
quote_en: Introduce a 2% tax on the net wealth of individuals above one million dollars
source_title: برنامج الحزب الشيوعي اللبناني للانتخابات النيابية 2022
grading_note: Party programme for the May 2022 election with a rate and threshold. The page shows no date, so the year is used; the site refused plain requests and the quote was read from the Wayback copy.

design_detail: one-time wealth tax on the richest; 10% on billionaires; annual tax on wealth later
quote_original: Lebanon should institute a one-time wealth tax on the richest Lebanese for the purpose of funding much-needed emergency relief: an exceptional 10 percent tax on billionaires would yield 2-3 percent of the national income
source_title: Lebanon’s Political Economy: From Predatory to Self-Devouring
grading_note: Recommends a one-off wealth tax with a rate and a later annual wealth tax. The page metadata gives 14 January 2021, the URL March 2021.

design_detail: exceptional tax on private capital, in particular real estate
quote_original: Moving from income to wealth, one option is to implement an exceptional tax on private capital, in particular on real estate.
grading_note: Names an exceptional tax on private capital as one option, no rate.

design_detail: 2% on net wealth over USD 1 million; inheritance tax of about 50% over USD 1 million
quote_original: An example of a wealth tax that can be imposed in Lebanon is a 2% tax on net wealth over $1 million
source_title: The Financial Recovery Plan: Its Impact on Lebanon’s Economic Model, Negotiations with the IMF, and Recession
grading_note: Critique of the April 2020 government plan that names a rate and threshold. The PDF carries no date; it answers the plan of 30 April 2020 and the bank association counterplan of 20 May 2020, so 2020.

design_detail: one-off wealth tax as one element of a mix; later a regular progressive wealth tax
quote_original: consider a one-off wealth tax as one element of a mix that will help resolve the current crisis in a socially fair manner
source_title: Which Tax Policies for Lebanon? Lessons from the Past for a Challenging Future
grading_note: The four authors (Bifani, Daher, Assouad, Diwan) ask for a one-off wealth tax to be considered; they do not set a rate. Graded C because the wording is "consider".

source_title: Which Tax Policies for Lebanon? Lessons from the Past for a Challenging Future
grading_note: Co-author named on the page; same text as the other authors. Graded C because the wording is "consider".

design_detail: solidarity transfer of 0.9% (lower poverty line) to 3.6% (upper) of top-decile wealth
quote_original: Implementing a solidarity transfer of 0.9 per cent and 3.6 per cent of top-decile wealth, respectively, would close these poverty gaps in 2020.
source_title: Wealth distribution and poverty impact of COVID-19 in Lebanon
grading_note: A levy on top-decile wealth that the report calls a solidarity transfer and, in a table note, a "solidarity tax"; it is modelled and advocated as a solidarity fund rather than drafted as a tax, so C.
